title: kith-store lib.rs: row_to_message pattern duplicated across get(), find_by_sender_msg_id() — already extracted but SELECT lists repeat
description: The SELECT list for messages (12 columns) is copy-pasted identically in get(), list_by_chat(), list_by_chat_paged(), and find_by_sender_msg_id(). The row_to_message function centralizes deserialization but not the query string. A future column addition requires updating 4 SELECT lists. Extract the column list as a const &str and reference it in each prepare_cached call. Suggested: const MSG_COLS: &str = 'id, chat_id, sender_user_id, body, body_type, sent_at_peer, created_at, delivery_state, delivered_at, read_at, reply_to, sender_msg_id';
